pages.title: Agenda
pages._note: Bespoke agenda compiler — assembles a meeting agenda from selected proposals with drag-ordering and section grouping; the compile-and-reorder workflow is not expressible as a standard index/detail page.

pages.title: Vergadering
pages._note: Bespoke meeting (vergadering) detail — combines agenda, attendees, voting and minutes into one working surface the standard detail type cannot express.
